same_jar_identity: Phase6Main.codeFingerprint hashes the complete packaged code source for both its Spark result and core config classes. The same assembled JAR therefore gives identical codeVersion; byte-identical Hadoop/ER manifest bindings plus equal Spark logical configuration give the same runId including nested context.runId.
